answer: Each identity must monthly present signed smart-meter readings from a unique service address showing 80 kWh drawn through its copper wiring, verified by the utility. A walnut-sized meter seal and a plume-shaped load curve make cloned readings detectable. Running 1,000 Sybils means renting 1,000 separately metered premises and paying about $45,000 monthly in real electricity and rent, with no shared meter allowed.
